verbs.name: media.intelligence_status
verbs.description: Read the current project's cited media-evidence coverage without running analysis. Reports whether the rebuildable MediaEvidenceIndex@1 is present and current for transcript, scene, beat, marker, metadata, and existing visual-index evidence. Every readiness claim is bound to the current asset hash and authoritative receipt/index hash; stale kinds are excluded by media.intelligence_search until rebuilt. No host paths are returned.

asset_ids.description: Optional exact project asset ids. Omit for all project media.

verbs.result: MediaIntelligenceStatus@1 {schema, index_id?, project_revision, complete, stale, entry_count, coverage:{transcript,visual,scene,beat,marker,metadata}, assets:[{asset_id,available,kinds:{kind:{source,indexed,state}}}]} — no paths

verbs.name: media.intelligence_rebuild
verbs.description: Durably rebuild the path-light MediaEvidenceIndex@1 from evidence Cut already owns: transcript words/speakers, perception scene/beat facts, current markers and media metadata, plus bindings to existing visual indexes. Returns a cancellable background job and runs behind the shared analysis limiter, so playback/render/record work is not given a second unbounded worker pool. This derivation does not transcribe media, run perception, or create missing visual embeddings; it names those missing sources in coverage instead of faking them. A changed project revision before publication refuses the stale snapshot.

asset_ids.description: Optional exact project asset ids. Omit to derive all project media.

kinds.description: Evidence kinds to derive. Omit for every currently supported kind.

verbs.result: {job_id}; jobs.status result becomes {schema:'shellx-cut/media-evidence-index/1', index_id, entry_count, assets, coverage, missing_sources} after atomic publication

verbs.name: media.intelligence_search
verbs.description: Search the current, rebuildable MediaEvidenceIndex@1 and return cursor-bounded EvidenceHit@1 citations. Exact transcript, marker, and metadata matches remain distinct from structural scene/beat matches and semantic visual similarity; scores from different evidence systems are never presented as one universal confidence. Each hit carries an opaque evidence id, sanitized excerpt, exact source range/anchor, current availability, authoritative provenance hashes, and bounded live timeline occurrences. Stale evidence is excluded, not returned with a warning. Visual similarity reads the existing media.index through the local text encoder; non-visual results remain usable when visual coverage/runtime is absent. Read-only and never moves the playhead, inserts media, or sends an agent turn.

query.description: Words spoken, a visual description, marker text, or media metadata to find.

scope.description: Default all_project_media. this_sequence excludes assets with no current-sequence occurrence.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same query/index snapshot.

verbs.result: EvidenceSearchResult@1 {schema, query, index_id, complete, stale_excluded, warnings, count, hits:[EvidenceHit@1 {evidence_id, asset_id, source_start_ms, source_end_ms, anchor_ms, kind, excerpt, match, relevance?, provenance:{kind,sha256}, available, occurrence_count, occurrences:[{sequence_id,clip_id,track_id,timeline_start_ms,timeline_end_ms}]}], next_cursor?}
